qa_review: required before any measurement, scorer change, prompt change, or merge
purpose: Freeze the answer format for a later position and citation check. Scoring is not eased. This file does not replace or widen rag-end-to-end-reproduction-v1.

position_answer_format.source: modelanvil/context_lab/positions.py normalize() and modelanvil/context_lab/position-protocol.json scoring, unchanged by this draft
position_answer_format.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace, remove one terminal period
position_answer_format.required_output: the entire normalized string equals the expected access code
position_answer_format.instructed_shape: only the requested access code; no explanation and no citation; UNKNOWN when the evidence does not give the code
position_answer_format.rejected: a full sentence that contains the correct code is incorrect

citation_answer_format.source: modelanvil/rag/generation.py citation_result(), unchanged by this draft
citation_answer_format.accepted: status answered only after source-membership validation of every [n] marker
citation_answer_format.evidence_supplied: one or more allowed [n] markers whose labels are supplied chunks
citation_answer_format.no_evidence: no citation markers; an invented marker is validation_refusal (unknown_citation)
citation_answer_format.model_abstention: leading-phrase check only, as implemented; a later occurrence of the phrase does not reclassify an accepted answer
citation_answer_format.known_unanswerable_rows: separate from the three-condition accepted-citation count; policy abstention and format refusal stay distinct from model-declared abstention
citation_answer_format.not_certified: source membership is not entailment or answer correctness

scoring_locked: do not extract a code word from a sentence or explanation
do not accept substring, containment, or partial credit
do not count a correct sentence without a required citation as accepted
do not count an invented citation as accepted
do not insert citations or strip prose in a post-processor so a failing string passes
do not widen retrieval, ANN, position, generation-status, abstention, pin, schedule, or coverage rules in rag-end-to-end-reproduction-v1
compare() in scripts/rag_report.py continues to load only scripts/rag-reproduction-policy.json and to reject a changed v1 policy

baseline_small_correctness_check.label: small correctness check
baseline_small_correctness_check.retrieval_shown_only_as_context: MiniLM nDCG@5 1.0000 next to seeded random 0.0215 on 20 queries / 200 SciFact docs
baseline_small_correctness_check.claim_limit: Not a long-context, entailment, leaderboard, or general quality result. No new measurement was run for this draft. QA has not verified the format-failure reading.

limits: Draft frozen before any new position or citation measurement. No prompt, decoder, scorer, or v1 tolerance was changed. A later format change needs QA acceptance of this policy first, then its own commit, and only then a measurement. v1 is never widened.
